known_source_limit: Legacy vfr.mp4 itself encodes final video duration 1001 and terminal 238238 ticks in stts/mdhd/tkhd/elst, although the producer authored 3003 and 240240. This is an encode/mux fixture limitation, not evidence of lost decoder metadata. The separate vfr-long-terminal.mp4 explicitly encodes the intended 3003-tick final picture without changing compressed data or PTS. The failed 48-byte software-vfr-b.mp4 encode was not admitted.
